fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-enabled", "false") == "true" && context.Request.Method != "OPTIONS" && Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-customer"]).Length > 0 && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-url", "").Trim().Length > 0)">
            
                @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-url", "").Trim())
                POST
                
                    application/json
                
                
                    @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-api-key") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-api-key"]) : "{{aforo-api-key}}")
                
                @{
                    var body = new JObject();
                    body["customerId"] = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-customer"]);
                    return body.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                }
            

            
                
                    <set-variable name="preflightDecision" value="@{
                        var fallback = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-fallback", "ALLOW").Trim().ToUpperInvariant() == "DENY" ? "DENY" : "ALLOW";
                        try {
                            var response = ((IResponse)context.Variables["preflightResponse"]);
                            if (response == null || response.StatusCode != 200) { return fallback; }
                            var body = response.Body.As();
                            /* The ingestor wraps every 2xx as success + data + meta. */
                            var data = body["data"] ?? body;
                            return data["decision"]?.ToString() ?? "ALLOW";
                        } catch {
                            return fallback;
                        }
                    }" />

                    
                        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("preflightDecision") == "DENY")">
                            
                                
                                
                                    application/json
                                
                                
                                    60
                                
                                {"message": "Rate limit exceeded"}
                            
                        
                        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("preflightDecision") == "WARN")">
                            
                                approaching-limit
